title: Rafael and the Cipher
author: Mara Okafor
blurb: Gideon Villalobos, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
